q: Can we use our discom's own fuel mix instead of the CEA grid factor?
title: Discom fuel mix vs CEA grid factor
short: For the location-based figure, no: use the grid average, which in India is the CEA factor. For the market-based figure, a supplier-specific rate can be used if it meets the GHG Protocol Scope 2 quality criteria, such as covering your exact supply and not being double counted. Few Indian discoms publish one.
audience: Factories with green tariffs or captive supply

sections.h: What a usable supplier rate needs
ul: Published by the supplier for the period.
Based on delivered electricity, not capacity.
Excludes renewable attributes sold to others.

p: Report location-based with the CEA factor, and market-based using certificates you hold or a residual mix approach.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
